paper.title: CVXPY: A Python-Embedded Modeling Language for Convex Optimization
paper.reference: Diamond and Boyd, Journal of Machine Learning Research 17(83):1–5 (2016)

paper_context.research_question: Can CVXPY express and solve a two-asset minimum-variance portfolio with an analytic optimum?
paper_context.method: Minimize quadratic portfolio variance subject to long-only fully-invested weights.
paper_context.data_and_splits: Synthetic diagonal covariance matrix under this repository's MIT license.
paper_context.training_or_inference: One tiny convex optimization with the open-source Clarabel solver.
paper_context.evaluation_protocol: Extract the first portfolio weight and compare with the analytic 0.8 optimum.
paper_context.limitations: Small exact optimization, not a solver-performance benchmark.

claims.protocol: Extract the first portfolio weight and compare with the analytic 0.8 optimum.
